My name is Rupesh Patel. I moved from Toronto, Ontario, to Vancouver
to study in the Master of Data Science program at UBC.

I have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering and previously
worked as a data engineer. Through this program, I hope to build my
understanding of statistics, data science, and machine learning.

After completing the program, I plan to work as a data scientist.
This website shares my background, experiences in MDS, and small
data analysis projects using Python and R.
